name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Data limits, Popular on friends' servers, direct downloads and many fixes. Data limits: set a monthly GB limit and a number of simultaneous streams per friend (Friends tab); it counts everything the friend gets from you, including titles you convert for them, and shows what they used this month. Popular on <friend>: Home shows what was most played on each friend's server in the last 30 days (counts only, never who; each side can switch it off in Advanced). Downloads to a device now go straight from the friend's server to your app in almost every case, including friends behind an https proxy configured with an http address. Speed test: a slow friend link is no longer capped above what it can carry (a 4 Mbps link was asked for 10 Mbps), one failed DNS lookup no longer removes the cap, the result shows in Playback Info, and very slow links keep their measurement. Fixes: rating limits treat TV and film ratings separately (TV-14 no longer lets NC-17 through; an unrecognised limit now blocks rated titles); a damaged cache file no longer deletes every friend title; a friend answering with an empty reply no longer removes all its titles at once; server downloads stop with a clear message when the disk is full and retry real interruptions on their own; a finished download is no longer reported as failed; cover art loads with one request per page again; faster segment handling for titles this server converts. Security: pool and friends-of-friends introductions only go to public or Tailscale addresses, servers that declined us are not asked again for 30 days, the federation token is never sent to a different host on a redirect. Web: no more constant page rescans while a download runs, download progress no longer freezes after one failed check. Data limits work with any friend version; Popular rows need the friend on 0.0.194.
